Show FOV Circle- Displays a visual circle showing your aimbot lock-on radius.

Target Part- Selects the body part for aimbot targeting (e.g., Head).

Enable Master ESP- Toggles all wallhack visual indicators on or off.

Draw Boxes- Renders 2D boxes around players through walls.

Show Names- Displays usernames above players through walls.

Health Bars- Displays health bars on target players through walls.

Show Distance- Displays distance in studs to each player.

Skeleton ESP- Displays skeleton wireframes on player models through walls.

Snapline Tracers- Draws direct tracer lines from your screen to other players.

Fly Engine (Key: F)- Toggles flight mode using the 'F' key.

Fly Speed- Adjusts movement speed while flying.

Master Noclip- Allows walking directly through walls and solid barriers.

Infinite Jump- Allows continuous mid-air jumping.

Walk Speed- Modifies character walking speed.

Jump Power- Modifies jump height.

Apply Gun Mods- Instantly enables infinite ammo and rapid fire on weapons.

Join Police / Guards Team- Switches team directly to Police/Guards.

Auto Arrest Criminals Loop- Continuously and automatically arrests all criminals on the server.

Arrest All Criminals- Instantly arrests every criminal in the game.

Custom Criminal Target Selection- Selects and arrests individual specific criminal targets.

Player Search / Teleport- Searches for specific players to target, view, or teleport to.

Teleport to Police Armory- Instantly teleports character into the police armory.

Teleport to Guard Tower- Instantly teleports character to the guard tower.

Teleport to Prison Yard- Instantly teleports character to the prison yard.

Teleport to Cafeteria- Instantly teleports character to the cafeteria.

Teleport to Criminal Base- Instantly teleports character to the criminal base.

Infinite Stamina- Grants unlimited stamina for continuous sprinting.

Anti-Arrest- Prevents police guards from cuffing or arresting you.

Give Building Tools- Adds standard building tools (BTools) to your inventory.
